INGEST_KEY.from: the maintainer; sent as the X-Ingest-Key header; never logged

conventions.newSourceRule: run a new or changed source with --dry-run once and compare counts before a real run
conventions.summaryLine: each command prints one JSON line with inserted, updated, unchanged and rejected; a non-zero exit is a failed step
conventions.rateLimit: at most 60 ingest calls per 15 minutes; batches of at most 200 items; wait Retry-After on 429
conventions.noOverlap: never run two jobs at once

jobs.name: events-refresh
jobs.success: every step exits 0 with rejected equal to 0; upcoming events on GET /api/stats never drop to 0 while a source has events
stop: any 401 from the API (do not retry)
rejected above 10 percent of items in a run
a source whose robots.txt now disallows its path
an item count that moved more than 25 percent since the last run

jobs.name: media-refresh
jobs.success: the seed answers 200 with every item unchanged or updated; the TMDB step reports posters equal to the number of items with a TMDB id when the bucket role is present, otherwise 0 and a warning
stop: the Wikidata step returning zero results two weeks running
jobs.notes: run the three in this order and never the seed alone: the seed re-sends the editorial layer and the TMDB step restores providers after it

jobs.name: organizations-and-guides
jobs.success: every step exits 0 with rejected equal to 0; guides land as drafts for an admin to publish

jobs.name: places-refresh
jobs.success: the dry run count is within 25 percent of the last real run before the real run starts; every step exits 0
stop: the OSM importer reporting that Overpass is not answering (try again the next day)
a dry-run count that moved more than 25 percent
jobs.notes: slow by design: Overpass is queried one tile at a time at one request per second; allow up to two hours

never: hold or request a session token, an admin role, a database connection string or a bucket credential
fetch Facebook, Instagram, Meetup or Eventbrite pages
send attendee, RSVP, organizer-person or any personal field
send an image URL as posterKey or hot-link an image
add a source at runtime; new sources arrive as a pull request to the allowlist
log the key, a request body or a full item
